name: rf
title: Robinson-Foulds
description: Robinson-Foulds distance over clades. The per-clade similarity gradient is not part of this metric: it comes from the pair's shared correspondence, and this metric's exact-match verdict is derived from it.

summary.label: Robinson-Foulds distance
summary.description: Clades present in one tree but not the other, summed over both directions: the symmetric difference |C(T1)\C(T2)| + |C(T2)\C(T1)|. Version 2 reports the full difference; version 1 halved it, following TreeDiff, and was exactly half of what DendroPy and ETE3 return.

summary.label: Normalised RF
summary.description: RF divided by the largest value it could take for these two trees, counting internal clusters excluding each root: 0 is identical, 1 shares no clade at all. In version 1 this divided the halved RF by the full maximum and so could never exceed 0.5.

columns.name: exact
columns.label: Clade present identically
columns.description: Whether this clade appears in the other tree with exactly the same leaves. Binary by nature and saturating on large clades, so it suits a filter or overlay rather than a colour scale.
